completeness_rule: Both full native catalog tables reach HTML EOF and agree on reread. Every listed Current and Former original member profile is acquired, its publisher-configured successful JSON body is complete, and every current/past term and item array is walked to EOF. Every full JSON member/term/item object agrees with an exact-request reread; shared term cores and item objects reconcile across members. Missing/error/incomplete/different responses refuse the entire catalog.
